name: midway-racer-web
description: Play Laguna Racer and 280-ZZZAP in the browser

scripts.wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --package midway-racer-web && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/wasm ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/midway_racer_web.wasm
scripts.build: npm run wasm && tsc && vite build
